title: Cobblemon Callisto
description: Non-Pay2Win survival server featuring all Pokémon, ultra-rare Luminous and Exalted shiny tiers, 400+ custom-textured Pokémon, permanent overworlds, Pokédex rank progression, earnable perks, weekly Legendary Raids and more!
body:
# 🌟 Welcome to Cobblemon Callisto! 🌟

Cobblemon Callisto is a relatively new Non-Pay2Win Survival server built from the ground up for a long-term, engaging, and community-focused Pokémon adventure.

The server is built to last, with no planned wipes for our main worlds and alot of planned features for the future.

## What Makes Callisto Unique?
### ✨ Custom Shiny Tiers
Inspired by PokéRogue, our server features not just standard shinies, but also ultra-rare Luminous and Exalted shinies! We have over 200 custom-textured Pokémon at launch, with the long-term goal of giving every single Pokémon its own unique shiny tier textures.

### 🌍 Choose Your World:
We offer two distinct Overworlds to build your legacy in!
Terralith: Explore breathtaking, custom biomes and landscapes.
Vanilla/Beta Hybrid: A nostalgic experience blending modern Minecraft with the feel of classic world generation.
Both worlds are permanent and filled with custom structures to discover.

### 🏆 Deep Progression Systems
Your journey is filled with goals and rewards.
Pokédex Ranks: Progress through 10 unique ranks by completing your Pokédex. Each rank-up grants you powerful perks and one-time rewards packed with valuable items.
Custom Titles: Unlock over 120 unique, tiered titles through our custom advancement system.
Levelables (Jobs): Level up professions like Mining or Pokémon Training to earn permanent, gameplay-enhancing buffs.

### 💖 A Fair & Rewarding Experience
Earn Your Power: All gameplay-altering perks (like /pc, extra homes, etc.) are unlocked by completing your Pokédex.
Support the Server: For those who wish to support our development, our store offers paid ranks that grant the perks of some Pokédex milestones as a "thank you" shortcut.
Earnable Cosmetics: You can earn a premium currency, Nova Crystals, through gameplay (events etc.). This allows you to get items from our cosmetic shop at a discount, or even completely for free, just by playing.

## Current Features

- ✅ | All Pokémon Implemented and obtainable: 99%+ are fully modeled
- ✨ | PokéRogue inspired Shiny Tiers: Luminous & Exalted with already over 200 custom textures
- 🥚 | Pokémon Breeding
- ⛓️ | Catch Combos
- 💿 | Move Tutors & TMs
- 📏 | Pokémon Size Variation:
- 🏆 | Pokédex Rank Progression
- ⛏️ | Jobs System: level up professions for permanent buffs.
- ✒️ | Over 120 Custom Prefix Titles
- 🎁 | Kits & Daily Reward Calendar
- 💰 | Player-Run Economy: Chest Shops for items & GTS for Pokémon.
- ❓ | WonderTrade
- 🎉 | Regular Events & Competitions
- 🗓️ | Weekly Shiny Days: decided by community votes!
- 🎤 | In-Game Voice Chat
- 🌍 | Dual Overworlds: Choose between Terralith or Vanilla/Beta Hybrid.
- 🛡️ | Land Claiming
- 🪑 | Custom Furniture
- ⚙️ | QoL Commands like /rtp, /tpa, /home, /back, etc.
- 🌀 | Server & Player Warps
- 🎨 | Custom Nicknames
- 🪓 | Vein Miner & Tree Feller
- 🚀 | Heavily Optimized for a smooth, lag-free experience.
